focus.zh: 电影 IP → 互动 VR

blurb.en: Turns beloved film characters into authored, interactive VR adventures.
blurb.zh: 把熟悉的电影角色变成可参与的 VR 故事。

strength.en: Production, technical development and distribution sit in the same group. Wallace & Gromit was made with Aardman and Meta.
strength.zh: 集团把制作、技术和发行串在一起，与 Aardman、Meta 联合制作《超级无敌掌门狗》VR 冒险。

limit.en: Authored interaction, not evidence of an open-ended AI cast.
limit.zh: 强项是导演设计的互动，不能等同于开放式 AI 角色。

funding.en: €5M round in January 2026, with HTC among the investors.
funding.zh: 2026 年 1 月完成一轮 500 万欧元融资，HTC 参与。

alt.en: Wallace & Gromit: The Grand Getaway — project still
alt.zh: 《超级无敌掌门狗》VR 项目剧照

blurb.en: In Fabula Rasa, you talk to characters and they react in real time.
blurb.zh: 《Fabula Rasa》里，观众开口，角色会当场回应。

strength.en: A handcrafted VR world gives improvised conversations a role in the story. The Line offers a contrasting, directed approach.
strength.zh: 在手工设计的 VR 世界里，把角色即兴回应放进叙事。《The Line》则展示了更强导演控制的做法。

limit.en: Live conversation does not establish a world that remembers previous visitors.
limit.zh: 角色能即兴说话，不等于世界会记住此前来过的观众。

funding.en: Founder confirms venture funding; no reliable public amount verified.
funding.zh: 创始人确认拿过风投；未核到可靠的公开金额。

label.en: Co-founder on ARVORE's first venture round
label.zh: 联合创始人谈首轮融资

blurb.en: Red Coast Echo makes audience choices part of a Chinese sci-fi world.
blurb.zh: 《三体：红岸回响》让观众在中国科幻世界里做选择。

strength.en: Three-Body Universe produced the VR film, made by its studio Dimension Interactive. Audience choices can lead to different endings.
strength.zh: 三体宇宙出品，旗下次元互动制作。观众做出的关键选择可以走向不同结局。

limit.en: The branches are authored. This is not evidence of AI improvising the narrative.
limit.zh: 分支来自事先设计，不等于 AI 即兴写剧情。

funding.en: No verified standalone round amount for Dimension Interactive.
funding.zh: 未核到次元互动可单列的融资金额。

label.zh: 北京国际电影节：《红岸回响》

focus.zh: VR 先驱 → 生成剧集

blurb.en: Wolves in the Walls makes a viewer part of Lucy's story.
blurb.zh: 《墙里的狼》让观众真正成为 Lucy 故事的一部分。

strength.en: An Emmy-winning example of a character noticing the viewer and building a relationship with them.
strength.zh: 拿过互动媒体 Emmy 的案例：角色注意到观众，并与观众建立关系。

limit.en: Its later Showrunner direction is generated episodic storytelling, not the same as a live VR world.
limit.zh: 后来的 Showrunner 主攻生成式剧集，和实时 VR 空间世界不是一回事。

funding.en: Amazon Alexa Fund invested in 2025; amount undisclosed.
funding.zh: 2025 年获 Amazon Alexa Fund 投资，金额未披露。

alt.en: Wolves in the Walls — official VR artwork
alt.zh: 《墙里的狼》官方 VR 视觉

label.en: Wolves in the Walls — official trailer and project
label.zh: 《墙里的狼》官方预告和项目页
翠贝卡电影节：《墙里的狼》
美国电视学院：2019 Emmy 档案

focus.zh: 多人全身追踪／门店规模化

blurb.en: Turns Squid Game and Deadwood into group experiences with ticket sales.
blurb.zh: 把《鱿鱼游戏》和《Deadwood》做成可售票的组队体验。

strength.en: Full-body tracking, repeatable venue formats and licensed alongside original stories. In October 2026 the company reported about 100 locations and US$300M in lifetime sales.
strength.zh: 把全身追踪、标准化场馆、授权与原创内容串起来。公司 2026 年 10 月披露约 100 个地点、累计销售额达 3 亿美元。

limit.en: The sales figure is not profit or financing. Its strongest public evidence is group play, not intimate, open-ended narrative.
limit.zh: 销售额不等于利润或融资。公开案例更能证明多人玩法，而非开放式作者叙事。

funding.en: US$116M subtotal: US$68M Series A and US$11M strategic funding in 2019; US$37M Series B in 2021. Not lifetime funding.
funding.zh: 三笔公开金额小计 1.16 亿美元：2019 年 A 轮 6800 万、战略轮 1100 万；2021 年 B 轮 3700 万。不是完整累计。

label.en: Company release: 100 locations and lifetime sales
label.zh: 公司公告：门店与累计销售额

blurb.en: Horizon of Khufu turns cultural history into a walkable story.
blurb.zh: 《消失的法老》把文化历史变成可以走进去的故事。

strength.en: The Immersive Expeditions format takes free-roaming groups through authored sequences and tours across venues.
strength.zh: Immersive Expeditions 把观众的自由行走放进导演编排的段落，可在多个场馆巡展。

limit.en: Requires space and venue operations; walking freely does not mean the story can branch freely.
limit.zh: 需要场馆和现场运营；能自由走动，不等于剧情能自由分支。

funding.en: €2.9M first round in 2020 from Bpifrance, HTC and ArtNova; not a lifetime total.
funding.zh: 2020 年首轮 290 万欧元，Bpifrance、HTC 与 ArtNova 参与；不是累计融资。

label.en: IDFA DocLab report: Fabien Barati on the format
label.zh: IDFA DocLab 报告：Fabien Barati 谈大空间体验

blurb.en: CultVRe adapts one act of The Nutcracker for Android XR.
blurb.zh: CultVRe 把《胡桃夹子》其中一幕搬进 Android XR。

strength.en: YB collaborates with San Francisco Ballet, Google and XREAL. The published plan sets the full Act I release for December 4, 2026.
strength.zh: 联手旧金山芭蕾舞团、Google 和 XREAL。官方计划于 2026 年 12 月 4 日发布完整第一幕。

limit.en: The case demonstrates immersive viewing and distribution, not AI characters or branching.
limit.zh: 证明的是沉浸观看和分发，不是 AI 角色或剧情分支。

funding.en: US$1.5M pre-Series A in 2021; research grants are separate.
funding.zh: 2021 年 Pre-A 轮 150 万美元；研发补助另计。

alt.en: San Francisco Ballet dancers in The Nutcracker
alt.zh: 旧金山芭蕾舞团《胡桃夹子》剧照

blurb.en: Combines XR production, equipment and venue operation.
blurb.zh: 把 XR 内容、设备和线下场馆放进同一个项目。

strength.en: Shougang and the Shanghai Disneytown Journey to the West venue illustrate large-scale delivery and operations.
strength.zh: 首钢一高炉与上海迪士尼小镇西游体验，展示了大型项目的交付与运营能力。

limit.en: Venue operations are central; a small story prototype does not need this overhead.
limit.zh: 场馆是模式核心；轻量叙事原型不必先背负这套运营成本。

funding.en: 2023 Series C: several hundred million yuan per Lenovo Capital. New strategic financing reported in 2026; amount undisclosed.
funding.zh: 据联想创投，2023 年 C 轮数亿元人民币；2026 年另有战略融资报道，金额未披露。

alt.en: SoReal project image from Lenovo Capital
alt.zh: 联想创投发布的 SoReal 项目图

label.en: SoReal cases at Shougang and Disneytown
label.zh: 首钢与迪士尼小镇案例

blurb.en: Makes and distributes immersive films, online and in Zero Space venues.
blurb.zh: 制作、联合出品并发行 VR 影视，也经营「零号空间」。

strength.en: VeeR Studio works with external IP and combines VR production with a distribution channel.
strength.zh: 自有工作室对接外部 IP，把 VR 制作和发行通道结合在一起。

limit.en: Distribution does not establish live AI characters or audience-driven branches.
limit.zh: 有发行能力，不代表已经验证实时 AI 角色或开放式剧情。

funding.en: Shanghai Fengyuzhu's strategic investment is confirmed; amount not disclosed.
funding.zh: 确认获风语筑战略投资，金额未披露。

alt.en: VeeR company visual from Qiming Venture Partners
alt.zh: 启明创投发布的 VeeR 相关视觉

label.en: Qiming on the studio and Zero Space
label.zh: 启明创投：工作室与零号空间

blurb.en: A technology layer for characters that can talk back.
blurb.zh: 让角色能开口回应的底层技术。

strength.en: The investor's original character-engine case and today's voice products show two different pieces of the workflow.
strength.zh: 早期的角色引擎和现在的语音产品，解决的是工作流中的不同环节。

limit.en: It does not design narrative rules, character arcs or shared world memory for you.
limit.zh: 不替创作者设计叙事规则、人物弧线或观众共享的世界记忆。

funding.en: Company reports over US$125M raised cumulatively. A 2023 round of more than US$50M is included, not additional.
funding.zh: 公司披露累计融资超 1.25 亿美元；已包含 2023 年的超 5000 万美元一轮。

alt.zh: Inworld 实时语音产品视觉

blurb.en: Marble and Atlas build spatial settings; a setting is not yet a story.
blurb.zh: Marble 与 Atlas 能做空间，但空间本身还不是故事。

strength.en: Useful for worldbuilding, camera exploration and reconstructing environments from images. AMD closed the acquisition in November 2026.
strength.zh: 可用于世界观搭建、探索机位和从图像重建空间。AMD 于 2026 年 11 月完成收购。

limit.en: Character behaviour and plot still need authoring. Marble is scheduled to close on January 8, 2027.
limit.zh: 角色和情节仍需创作。Marble 公告将于 2027 年 1 月 8 日停服。

funding.en: About US$1.23B across the 2024 reported US$230M and 2026 company-announced US$1B. AMD's announced US$8.2B acquisition price is not funding.
funding.zh: 2024 年报道 2.3 亿美元，2026 年官宣 10 亿美元，合计约 12.3 亿美元；AMD 公告的约 82 亿美元收购价不是融资。

alt.en: Frameboy: Atlas in real-time — official example

label.en: World Labs: US$1 billion financing in 2026
label.zh: World Labs：2026 年 10 亿美元融资

label.en: TechCrunch: historical funding and the 2026 round
label.zh: TechCrunch：早期融资与 2026 年融资

blurb.en: Builds simulations that change as you act inside them.
blurb.zh: 让数字环境随着人的输入实时变化。

strength.en: Good reference for testing an environment that responds to audience actions in real time.
strength.zh: 适合研究观众的动作如何改变眼前发生的事。

limit.en: Not a finished narrative engine for dramatic beats, editorial control or persistent shared stories.
limit.zh: 不是能直接交付故事节奏、导演控制或多人共享剧情的叙事系统。

funding.en: US$310M Series B in June 2026. US$1.45B was the valuation, not funding.
funding.zh: 2026 年 6 月 B 轮 3.1 亿美元；14.5 亿美元是估值，不是募资。

alt.zh: Odyssey 世界模拟官方视觉

blurb.en: Space Explorers made the viewer feel physically present in orbit.
blurb.zh: 《Space Explorers》让观众感觉自己真的身处轨道。

strength.en: Cinematic depth, spatial sound and staging show how presence can carry a story even without branches.
strength.zh: 用空间声音、景深和场面调度证明：没有剧情分支，也可以靠临场感讲故事。

limit.en: The original entity filed for bankruptcy in September 2026. Treat rights and commissioning status as unverified.
limit.zh: 原公司 2026 年 9 月申报破产。作品权利与可合作主体需另行确认。

funding.en: US$6.8M Series A in 2016; not a current funding or operating claim.
funding.zh: 2016 年 A 轮约 680 万美元，不代表当前融资或运营状态。

label.zh: 洛杉矶时报：2016 年 A 轮
